title: exacum courtallense var. travancorica
intro: Exacum courtallense var. travancorica, commonly known as Travancore exacum, is a plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Travancore exacum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
